SELECT e.socintscore, e.engrate, e.actdayswk, e.avgsesscount, 
       m.spendusd, m.membdays,
       l.inflscore, l.trustval,
       r.contreach, r.refcount, r.viralcont
FROM engagement e
JOIN membershipandspending m ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
JOIN loyaltyandachievements l ON e.engagereg = l.loyaltyengagepivot
JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON e.engagereg = r.retainengagepivot
LIMIT 5;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_fei(
    socintscore_in NUMERIC,
    engrate_in NUMERIC,
    actdayswk_in SMALLINT,
    avgsesscount_in SMALLINT,
    spendusd_in NUMERIC,
    inflscore_in NUMERIC,
    trustval_in NUMERIC,
    contreach_in INTEGER,
    refcount_in SMALLINT,
    merchspendusd_in NUMERIC,
    collcomprate_in NUMERIC,
    npsval_in SMALLINT,
    satrate_in NUMERIC
) RETURNS NUMERIC AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN (
        socintscore_in * 0.15 +
        engrate_in * 100 * 0.20 +
        actdayswk_in * 3.0 +
        avgsesscount_in * 2.0 +
        LEAST(spendusd_in / 100.0, 100.0) * 0.10 +
        inflscore_in * 0.10 +
        trustval_in * 0.05 +
        LEAST(contreach_in / 1000.0, 100.0) * 0.05 +
        LEAST(refcount_in * 5.0, 100.0) * 0.05 +
        LEAST(merchspendusd_in / 100.0, 100.0) * 0.05 +
        collcomprate_in * 0.05 +
        LEAST(npsval_in, 10) * 2.0 +
        LEAST(satrate_in, 5.0) * 4.0
    );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

The formula used to calculate the Fan Engagement Index is: `(eng_rate * 0.4) + (social_score / 100 * 0.3) + (active_days / 7 * 0.2) + (avg_sessions / 10 * 0.1)`.
